_doc: DERIVED, T-1469, by tools/spend_trade_premises.py from the resident layer and the pass findings beside it -- run --check to re-derive it. The 37 `corroborated_enrichment` units naming a trade, a shop, a tavern, a store or the premises one was kept at, each read against the finished business layer and given one of six outcomes. Nothing here writes a card: every field a row names was written by the pass that owns it, and this register records which field answers which finding.
